package grpcserver

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/ourstudio-se/puan-sdk-go/puan"

	"google.golang.org/grpc"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/reflection"

	"github.com/volvo-cars/caas-car-configurator/internal/api/grpcserver/interceptors"
	"github.com/volvo-cars/caas-car-configurator/internal/domain/ruleset"
	"github.com/volvo-cars/caas-car-configurator/internal/domain/specification"

	loggingsdk "github.com/volvo-cars/ooe-product-offer-logging"

	"github.com/volvo-cars/caas-car-configurator/internal/api/grpcserver/contracts"
)

type CarKeyCalculator interface {
	CalculateCarKeyV2(
		ctx context.Context,
		rulesetID uuid.UUID,
		selections puan.Selections,
		fromWeek *specification.StructureWeek,
		toWeek *specification.StructureWeek,
	) (ruleset.CarKey, error)
	CalculateManyCarKeys(
		ctx context.Context,
		rulesetID uuid.UUID,
		selectionGroups []puan.Selections,
		fromWeek *specification.StructureWeek,
		toWeek *specification.StructureWeek,
	) (ruleset.CarKeysBySelectionGroup, error)
}

type CarRulesetCreator interface {
	Create(
		ctx context.Context,
		specification specification.CarSpecification,
	) (uuid.UUID, error)
}

type CarRulesetDeleter interface {
	DeleteRuleset(
		ctx context.Context,
		id uuid.UUID,
	) error
}

type CarSpecificationReader interface {
	GetCarSpecification(
		ctx context.Context,
		rulesetID uuid.UUID,
	) (specification.CarSpecification, error)
}

type StartCarKeysCalculator interface {
	CalculateStartCarKeys(
		ctx context.Context,
		rulesetID uuid.UUID,
	) ([]ruleset.CarKeyInPeriod, error)
}

type BaseCarKeyCalculator interface {
	Calculate(
		ctx context.Context,
		rulesetID uuid.UUID,
	) (ruleset.BaseCarKeys, error)
}

type NextCarKeyCalculator interface {
	Calculate(
		ctx context.Context,
		rulesetID uuid.UUID,
		currentSelections puan.Selections,
		from *specification.StructureWeek,
		to *specification.StructureWeek,
	) ([]ruleset.CarKeyForSelection, error)
}

type Server struct {
	contracts.UnimplementedCarConfigurationServiceServer

	carKeyCalculator       CarKeyCalculator
	rulesetCreator         CarRulesetCreator
	rulesetDeleter         CarRulesetDeleter
	startCarKeysCalculator StartCarKeysCalculator
	baseCarKeyCalculator   BaseCarKeyCalculator
	nextCarKeyCalculator   NextCarKeyCalculator
	carSpecificationReader CarSpecificationReader

	logger *loggingsdk.Logger
}

func NewServer(
	operationIDInterceptor *interceptors.OperationIDInterceptor,
	panicInterceptor *interceptors.PanicInterceptor,
	errorInterceptor *interceptors.ErrorInterceptor,
	authInterceptor *interceptors.AuthInterceptor,
	loggingInterceptor *interceptors.LoggingInterceptor,
	metricsInterceptor *interceptors.MetricsInterceptor,

	carKeyCalculator CarKeyCalculator,
	rulesetCreator CarRulesetCreator,
	rulesetDeleter CarRulesetDeleter,
	startCarKeysCalculator StartCarKeysCalculator,
	baseCarKeyCalculator BaseCarKeyCalculator,
	nextCarKeyCalculator NextCarKeyCalculator,
	carSpecificationReader CarSpecificationReader,

	logger *loggingsdk.Logger,
) *grpc.Server {
	server := grpc.NewServer(
		grpc.ChainUnaryInterceptor(
			operationIDInterceptor.Intercept,
			panicInterceptor.Intercept,
			errorInterceptor.Intercept,
			metricsInterceptor.Collect,
			loggingInterceptor.LogRequestFailure,
			authInterceptor.Intercept,
			loggingInterceptor.LogRequest,
		),
	)

	serverImpl := &Server{
		carKeyCalculator:       carKeyCalculator,
		rulesetCreator:         rulesetCreator,
		rulesetDeleter:         rulesetDeleter,
		startCarKeysCalculator: startCarKeysCalculator,
		baseCarKeyCalculator:   baseCarKeyCalculator,
		nextCarKeyCalculator:   nextCarKeyCalculator,
		carSpecificationReader: carSpecificationReader,
		logger:                 logger,
	}
	contracts.RegisterCarConfigurationServiceServer(server, serverImpl)

	reflection.Register(server)

	return server
}

func (c *configurationRulesetCreator) addColorComponent(color specification.Color) error {
	return c.newComponentConfigurator(color.Code()).
		withRequiredTimeBoundAtLeastOnes(color.RequiredOptions()).
		withRequiredTimeBoundExactlyOnes(color.RequiredWheels()).
		withForbidden(color.ForbidsOptions()).
		withForbidden(color.ForbidsWheels()).
		withForbidden(color.ForbidsUpholsteries()).
		configure()
}

func (rt *MetricsRoundTripper) RoundTrip(req *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	start := time.Now()

	resp, err := rt.next.RoundTrip(req)

	duration := time.Since(start).Milliseconds()
	rt.collectMetrics(req, resp, duration)

	return resp, err
}
